items.title: Dinusha Douthy scores unbeaten 112 runs partnership for Sri Lanka in Colombo Test against India
items.whyInNews: On 24 August 2026, Sri Lankan batsman Dinusha Douthy and partner forged a 112‑run seventh‑wicket stand lasting 174 minutes and 246 balls, thwarting India's chase in the Colombo Test at R. Premadasa Stadium.
items.summary: Dinusha Douthy of Sri Lanka scored an unbeaten 112 runs in a seventh‑wicket partnership on 24 August 2026 at R. Premadasa Stadium, Colombo, lasting 174 minutes and 246 balls. The partnership helped Sri Lanka resist India's target, leading to a drawn result in the Test match. This performance highlighted Sri Lanka's lower‑order resilience in the five‑day Test series against India.
